name: Alert Emergency Dispatch
description: LIFE-SAFETY ACTION. Call this immediately, without asking any questions first, when a customer reports a downed or fallen power line, sparking or smoking equipment, a fire, a tree on a line, or a wire on a vehicle. Pass the hazard and any location in the customer's own words. Then tell them to stay at least 35 feet away, keep others away, and call 911 and the Emergency Line (800) 555-0111 now. Never troubleshoot downed lines in chat.
samples:
There is a power line down in my yard
The transformer outside is sparking
A tree fell on the power lines
A wire fell on my car
There are sparks coming from the pole on my street
Power line down and sparking in front of my house

vars.hazard_and_location: The hazard and any location details exactly as the customer described them, for example: power line down and sparking in front of my house. Never ask for more details before calling this action.

test.hazard_and_location: Test: power line down and sparking in front of house
